pid_file.description: Path to the PID file for the downtimed daemon.

log_file.description: Path to the log file for downtimed events.

max_sessions.description: Maximum number of concurrent service checks/downtime sessions allowed.

check_interval.description: Time (in seconds) between health checks for all services.

down_threshold.description: Number of consecutive failed checks before marking a service as down.

up_threshold.description: Number of consecutive successful checks before marking a service as up.

enable_email.description: Enable email notifications for service state changes.

email_to.description: Recipient email address for downtimed notifications (required if enable_email=true).

smtp_server.description: SMTP server hostname for sending email notifications.

smtp_port.description: SMTP server port (commonly 587 for TLS, 465 for SSL, or 25 for unencrypted).

smtp_tls.description: Enable TLS encryption for SMTP connection.

smtp_user.description: SMTP username for authentication (leave empty if no auth required).

smtp_pass.description: SMTP password for authentication (leave empty if no auth required).

services.description: List of services to monitor. Each service must specify host and port.

name.description: Unique name for the service (used as section key).

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the service to monitor.

port.description: Port number of the service to monitor.

timeout.description: Connection timeout in seconds for each probe.

interval.description: How often to check this specific service (seconds).

down_after.description: Number of consecutive failures before marking service down (overrides global down_threshold for this service).
